notes.regional_base: Temporary reuse of a closely related regional language for unreviewed UI terminology.
notes.related_language_base: Temporary reuse of a related language where no direct reviewed Controlling translation exists; intended for later native review.
notes.code_rename: Same language under a newer Minecraft locale identifier.
notes.script_base: Temporary reuse of the same or closely related language in another script.
notes.historical_base: Temporary reuse of the modern form of the same language.
